notes.title: New languages ​​and Linux version now available!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, ninja masters, we want to announce some amazing news for Katana Dragon! 🥷[/h3]

[h2][b]Five new languages[/b] and a Linux version [b]fully compatible with Steam Deck[/b] are now available! 🎮✅[/h2]

[h3][b]New languages:[/b]
[list][*] Català (Catalan)
[*] Italiano (Italian)
[*] Français (French)
[*] Tagalog (Tagalog)
[*] 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese)[/list][/h3]

[h3]🎁 And that's not all! Katana Dragon will also have a [b]20% discount[/b] from May 15th to 24th! 🎁[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303010/Katana_Dragon/

[b]A huge thank you for supporting us in this adventure! 🙏[/b]

If you experience any technical issues, please reach out in the Steam discussions. Your feedback has been the driving force behind many improvements in the game, and it will continue to shape its development.

We’d love for you to spread the word to your favorite streamers and YouTube creators—your support truly means the world to us!

[h3][b]Enjoy the game! 🐉[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Demo Update for Feb 21 (v0.5-demo)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]v0.5-demo[/b][/h1]
Additions, performance improvements and bug fixes noted below:

[h1][b]0.5-demo[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New 'Game Over' cinematic
[*] New 'Game Over' screen
[*] New 'Skip Dialog' functionality
[*] New 'Autosave' behaviour
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixed[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Shin skin
[*] Carriable and pusheable objects
[*] Idle animation
[*] Bamboo destruction
[*] Interior lamps
[*] Shader caching
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Lots of bug fixes and stability improvements
[/list]

[h3][b]Changed[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New engine version
[*] Better lighting
[*] Better enemies behaviour
[*] New character voices for chests and wells
[*] Better interactive tooltip responsiveness
[*] Better Sensei Ghost animations
[*] Better combat feedback
[*] Better 'Continue' checkpoint management
[/list]

We hope you're enjoying the Katana Dragon demo so far. More news coming soon!
Thanks so much for playing!
